name: work
summary: The plan as facts: work items and milestones over the product's requirements, features and components, each open, blocked (on whom, why) or deployed, the state derived from dated transitions and never written on the item; messages beside the item they are about (the communication ontology, on work): a notification from a block to whom it waits on, the inbox a session opens with, replies that lift the block, reminders past a due date. oto work set, board, notify, inbox, reply, event and remind come with the pack; the engine ships no work of its own.

changelog.note: Brought to the engine's line and made the only work there is (ADR-0010): the work ontology at release 7 and communication at release 3, the commands (oto work set, board, notify, inbox, reply, event, remind) and the board's status hook as the module oto_work in ontology/work/code, the SessionStart hook that opens a session with the inbox, the work skill beside feature-flow, the engine's tests and the roadmap scenario beside it. Needs OTO 0.14.7.
feature-flow rebuilds the studio when a feature is done.
feature-flow asks the implement, deploy and end-to-end briefs before acting, and stops when one is blocked.
Every conversation in plain language: no codes, ids or engine output, technical details only when asked (engine 0.11.22).
feature-flow captures through OTO's capture-form (elicit is gone).
feature-flow, a feature through the gates, moves here from prd-architecture-studio. Needs OTO 0.11.17.
Refreshed on engine 0.11.10: the bases of today's engine.
stage 5: the report arc on OTO 0.11 (knowledge programme)

_about: The pack's identity: its release rises on every published change; `ontology` names the ontology embedded under ontology/ and where it came from; `domain` is the category it belongs to.
